{{Quote|Well, I hate the idea of being played ''a dupe''&hellip; But I guess if it was for the greater cause, then I'm happy to have served.|Anise I'Zak, to Ki-Adi-Mundi and Aayla Secura|<ref name="CoC" />}}
'''Anise I'Zak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], I'zak was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hitaka]], where she received a [[Mission on Hitaka|mission]] from [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to deliver a canister to the [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Hitaka)|clone commander]] of [[Base "B"|one]] of the Republic bases on the world. During her quest, she encountered numerous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], who tried to halt her progress. In one of the skirmishes between I'Zak and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the canister was destroyed. After fighting through more enemy forces, I'Zak reached the base and delivered the broken canister, only to discover that Mundi and Secura had used her presence as a decoy so that they could carry out the actual mission that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had given them. I'Zak accepted that fact and expressed her willingness to serve the Republic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm afraid I ''failed'', Commander. The canister was destroyed. Though the Separatists will have quite the repair bill&hellip;"''<br />"''Don't judge your mission a failure ''too quickly'', Master I'Zak.|Anise I'Zak and Aayla Secura|<ref name="CoC" />}}
Anise I'Zak, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During her youth, she was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. I'Zak possessed an insolent attitude and a habit for causing trouble, traits many [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] believed would prevent her from [[Jedi Trials/Legends|ascending]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|126|I'Zak, Anise}}</ref>&mdash;which initiated the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>&mdash;I'Zak managed to pass the Trials necessary to become a Knight, although she did so through unconventional methods, and was thus granted Knighthood status.<ref name="CSWE" />

Shortly after her promotion, I'Zak was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hitaka]], where she met with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] at a Republic-controlled station. During the meeting, Mundi [[Mission on Hitaka|tasked]] I'Zak with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] a secret canister across enemy lines to one of the Republic camps on the east side of the world, [[Base "B"]], and she was forewarned about the [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of CIS [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and fields. As she was making the trek to the base, I'Zak was attacked by some of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droids]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Army]], though she was able to defeat them before coming across an occupied house. She was ambushed once more by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], causing her to crash into the house and interrupt a [[Unidentified Hitaka species|native]] family's dinner. With the aid of the family, I'Zak defeated the droidekas but not before one of them shot and destroyed the canister she was carrying. She was left in despair for a moment, but the arrival of a group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] prompted her to engage and destroy them all to vent her feelings.<ref name="CoC" />

I'Zak arrived at Base "B" by dusk and gave the broken canister to the [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Hitaka)|clone commander]], remarking that her mission had been a failure. However, Mundi and Secura surprised I'Zak and told her that her mission was a success, in that she provided an adequate distraction for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|armies]] while the [[General/Legends|Generals]] carried out the true objective that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had given them. Although she disliked being used in that way, she recognized that it was in the best interests of the Republic.<ref name="CoC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm just glad to be rid of the ''braid''. It was always getting caught whenever I'd work on my speeder. A real pain in the rear deflector, you know&hellip;?|Anise I'Zak, to Ki-Adi-Mundi and Aayla Secura|<ref name="CoC" />}}
Anise I'Zak was light-skinned and had freckles on her face. She had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and wore a set of brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. During battle, I'Zak used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="CoC" /> She was known for her brazen attitude. She would often use expletives to either help herself conquer her emotions or to conceal her errors.<ref name="CSWE" /> Many of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters felt that her attitude would be a hindrance to her ascending to the rank of Jedi Knight.<ref name="CSWE" /> However, she was able to pass her Trials by using unorthodox methods. When she initially met with Mundi and Secura, she expressed disdain for the [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]] she used to wear, and also noted her affinity for repairing her [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. After the canister she was carrying was destroyed, I'Zak displayed remorse over her apparent failure and took her anger out on a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of super battle droids. Upon finding out from Mundi and Secura that she was merely a decoy, I'Zak came to the conclusion that the Jedi Generals had leaked information to the Separatists about her whereabouts, although she acknowledged that it was in the best interests of completing the mission and that she was glad to have served.<ref name="CoC" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You passed your Jedi trials with skillful, though perhaps ''unorthodox'', methods.|Ki-Adi-Mundi, to I'Zak|<ref name="CoC" />}}
I'Zak was a skilled Jedi, enough to be promoted to Knighthood even if she used less than traditional methods, and displayed proficiency in combat against the droid armies on Hitaka, using acrobatics to evade the droids' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire as well as her lightsaber against them. During one skirmish, she used [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to use her lightsaber and destroy three droids who ordered her to surrender. I'Zak also displayed an ability to [[Tutaminis|absorb]] blaster energy with her [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="CoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anise I'Zak first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[Chain of Command (comic story)|Chain of Command]]," written by [[Jason Hall]], penciled by [[Ethan Beavers]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 10|tenth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] trade paperbacks<ref name="CoC" /> on [[December 19]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-624/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-10|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 10}}</ref>
